Bento for macOS 0.2.17
What’s new
- Drag a tiled window to the outer screen edge to move its whole section. A large right slot can move left while the stacked left slots move right together, preserving their sizes and internal split. - Preview every affected slot before releasing a section move. Undo restores the original grouping and ratios. - Closing a window smoothly expands the remaining slots, respecting animation settings and Reduce Motion. - Keep gap grabbers below app windows and above the dark backdrop, visible only on hover or while held. - Keep normal window swaps and hold-to-split gestures inside the layout. - Show a dim outline menu-bar icon while Bento is off and a filled white icon while it is active. - Group the menu-bar right-click menu into Layout, Layout history, Desktop and Bento, with a combined Hide Dock & Menu Bar toggle. - Organize settings into Layout & spacing, Desktop, Appearance & motion, and General, with switches aligned to the far right.
